notes: SKELETON: replace the store, dateChecked and prices below with real own-brand prices from one supermarket. item = ingredient name (spelling and plurals do not matter). packSize + unit = what is in one pack (unit is one of g, kg, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, tin, slice, rasher, clove, thumb, ball, handful, or null for a plain count, e.g. a box of 6 eggs). packPrice = price of ONE pack in pounds. An item only gets a price if its unit is the same kind as the recipe's (weight, volume, or the identical count unit); otherwise the list says 'price unknown'. The server checks this file when it starts and stops with a clear message if anything is wrong.
